descriptions.w3d_s4_selection_reset: Releases the pending handle, clears entries, and resets the embedded controller.
descriptions.w3d_s4_selection_set_active: Updates selection activation and two child state fields, then refreshes visibility.
descriptions.w3d_s4_selection_value_changed: Reads the current typed value and updates the matching highlighted entry.
descriptions.w3d_s4_selection_navigate: Moves the selected entry, optionally wraps at the ends, and returns its value.
